linkedAccounts.title: Linked Chess Accounts
linkedAccounts.description: Link your Lichess and Chess.com accounts so your latest game is ready to review as soon as you open the analysis page.
linkedAccounts.chessComInstructions: To prove {{username}} is your account, paste this code into the "Location" field of your Chess.com profile, save it, then press Verify. You can change it back afterwards.
linkedAccounts.chessComLinked: Your Chess.com account has been linked.
linkedAccounts.chessComNotFound: No Chess.com account exists with that username.
linkedAccounts.chessComInvalid: Something went wrong. Please check the username and try again.
linkedAccounts.chessComCodeMissing: The code wasn't found in your Chess.com Location yet. Save your profile on Chess.com, wait a few seconds, and try again.
linkedAccounts.lichessLinked: Your Lichess account has been linked.
linkedAccounts.lichessFailed: Your Lichess account could not be linked. Please try again.
